features.name: mean_comment_title_vocab_overlap
features.definition: On average across counter-argument comments, what proportion of a comment's distinct words also appear in the OP's CMV title?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as a JSON list of strings (malformed/missing -> null; empty list -> null). Strip a leading 'CMV:' (case-insensitive) from title. Tokenize title and each comment: lowercase, regex [a-z0-9']+ . Title vocabulary = set of title tokens (no stopword removal; if the title has no tokens -> null). For each comment with at least one token, overlap = |distinct comment tokens in title vocabulary| / |distinct comment tokens|. Comments with no tokens are skipped. Return the mean overlap across comments; null if no comment has tokens.

h0: mean_comment_title_vocab_overlap has no association with the probability that the OP changed their view (delta).
h1: Lower mean_comment_title_vocab_overlap is associated with a higher probability of delta (negative coefficient).
note: Operational assumptions: 'overlap with title vocabulary' is the mean per-comment share of distinct comment tokens found in the title tokens, with no stopword removal or stemming; this is a lexical proxy, and the 'fresh perspectives' mechanism is not measured. Comments are pooled from OC_comments, which has no order or timing; they may include text after the outcome (e.g. delta announcements); raw text is not outcome-free. Short comments give noisier shares. Association only, not causal.
